Micron Technology (MU) reported earnings of $33.42 per share on revenue of $54.23 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $31.41 per share on revenue of $50.86 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $34.14 per share. The company missed expectations by 2.11%.

Thursday, September 3, 2026, 4:05 PM ET

Zscaler (ZS) reported earnings of $1.19 per share on revenue of $898.19 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended July 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.09 per share on revenue of $877.14 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.13 per share. The company beat expectations by 5.31% while revenue grew 24.88% on a year-over-year basis.
